regions.full_page: Family Reconciled. Thanks be to God! Thanks to Seraphic Mass Asso- ciation! Mr. & Mrs. McK. Estranged since last July and separated to the sorrow of etc. of child & friends - having enrolled themselves and each other, meet in the Monastery as promoters of same S.M.A. - and shake hands and kiss, weeping in reconciliation. Thanks be to God! Deo Gr. July 11, 1932 This sad case, as it turned again to be shortly after note above was made, was drawn out a year and 6 mo. away then re- concisled and child given ( after other break) to father: brought to court. To-night reported earnestly gone to confession, anointed, wants to see Fr. Sol.
